groups.groupName: Tier 1 - Safest Choice: Grilled & Steamed Whole Fish Sets
groups.comparisonSentence: Compared to fried rice and noodles, these grilled fish sets provide significantly higher protein density and beneficial omega-3 fatty acids with lower saturated fat.
groups.message: These grilled fish selections are the healthiest choices on the menu, helping close your protein deficit while keeping saturated fat in check. They supply essential omega-3 fatty acids and lean protein. However, watch out for added sweet soy marinades that can elevate sodium and sugar. Pair with plain rice and request minimal oil during grilling.
groups.orderingTip: Ask for grilled fish with minimal sweet soy glaze and request sambal on the side to control sodium and sugar intake.

groups.groupName: Tier 2 - Moderate Choice: Grilled Poultry & Sour Broth Dishes
groups.comparisonSentence: Unlike fried fast foods, these grilled poultry and clear broth dishes offer solid protein but require moderation due to higher sodium content.
groups.message: These options provide a balanced source of poultry protein and soothing broths. While they avoid the extreme trans fats of deep-frying, dishes like garang asem and sweet-and-sour preparations carry notable sodium and sugar loads that can impact your daily targets. Enjoy in moderation and balance with fresh vegetables.
groups.orderingTip: Choose clear sour broths over heavy sweet and sour sauces to keep added sugar and refined carbohydrates under control.

groups.groupName: Tier 3 - Caution Choice: Deep-Fried Proteins & Spicy Dishes
groups.comparisonSentence: Compared to grilled fish, these deep-fried proteins significantly exacerbate your saturated fat and sodium excesses.
groups.message: Deep-fried squid, chicken, and spicy sambal dishes contribute heavily to your already elevated saturated fat and sodium intake. While they supply essential protein, the frying process and heavy spice pastes introduce oxidized oils and metabolic strain. Consume infrequently and avoid pairing with extra oily sides.
groups.orderingTip: Scrape off excess fried batter and limit chili sambal portions to reduce oil and sodium absorption.

groups.groupName: Tier 4 - Alert Choice: Fried Rice, Noodles, and Seblak Dishes
groups.comparisonSentence: These fried rice, noodle, and seblak dishes drastically worsen your existing carbohydrate, calorie, and sodium excesses compared to all other options.
groups.message: These carbohydrate-dense fried rice, street noodles, and seblak dishes will severely aggravate your 39% calorie excess and 32% carbohydrate excess while adding massive sodium loads. They lack sufficient fiber and promote rapid glycemic spikes and metabolic strain. Avoid these items entirely given your current nutritional targets.
groups.orderingTip: Steer clear of fried noodles, fried rice, and seblak entirely to protect against severe carbohydrate and sodium overload.
